en.title: Slovenia snow report today: snow depth and new snow, 17 November 2026
en.description: Slovenia snow today, 17 November: snow cover, new snow, snow depth by height, the next days and the best resorts.
en.lede: Snow covers roughly 430 km² in Slovenia on 17 November, 700 km² lost since yesterday. In other words, 6 % of the mapped high ground is white.

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: A week ago it was 150 km², so the cover has grown by 280 km². Most of the ground is white from about 2,000 m up.

sections.h: From the valleys to the summits
p: Average depth of the snowpack by height band: 500-1,000 m: on average under 1 cm (2 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average under 1 cm (9 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 1 cm (28 % of the ground white); 2,000-2,500 m: on average 4 cm (73 % of the ground white).
The last three days were dry or nearly so, with no more than 2 cm anywhere.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.
The week ahead could bring up to 7 cm, 7 cm of it in the next three days.
Thursday 19 November stands out, with up to 6 cm in a day.
The second week adds up to 22 cm where it snows most.
At the top of the list, Vogel reports 23 cm.
Then come Velika planina (21 cm), Golte (11 cm), Rogla (11 cm) and Sella Nevea (9 cm).
Vogel picked up 2 cm in the last three days and could add 2 cm by Friday 20 November.
Velika planina had no fresh snow in the last three days; 1 cm could fall by Friday 20 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 13 out of 27 resorts in Slovenia.

advice: Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.
Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.

sl.title: Koliko snega je v Sloveniji? Snežna odeja in napoved, 17. novembra 2026
sl.description: Sneg v Sloveniji 17. novembra: snežna odeja, novi sneg, višina po nadmorski višini, naslednji dnevi in najboljša smučišča.
sl.lede: V Sloveniji je danes pod snegom približno 430 km² (torek, 17. novembra). To je 700 km² manj kot včeraj. To je 6 % gorskega območja v Sloveniji, ki ga spremljamo.

p: V primerjavi z 150 km² pred sedmimi dnevi je to 280 km² več. Teren je večinoma bel približno od 2.000 m navzgor.

Višina snega je odvisna od nadmorske višine: 500–1.000 m: povprečno manj kot 1 cm (2 % pod snegom); 1.000–1.500 m: povprečno manj kot 1 cm (9 % pod snegom); 1.500–2.000 m: povprečno 1 cm (28 % pod snegom); 2.000–2.500 m: povprečno 4 cm (73 % pod snegom).
Zadnje tri dni skoraj ni snežilo: največ 2 cm.
Odjuga načenja odejo: zjutraj trd sneg, popoldne moker.
Napoved novega snega: do 7 cm v treh dneh in do 7 cm v sedmih dneh.
Najbolj snežen dan: četrtek, 19. novembra, do 6 cm.
Največ snega na zgornjih progah: Vogel, 23 cm.
Smučišča s snegom na zgornjih progah: 13 od 27.
Sledijo: Velika planina (21 cm), Golte (11 cm), Rogla (11 cm) in Sella Nevea (9 cm).
Vogel: 2 cm novega snega v treh dneh in do datuma petek, 20. novembra še do 2 cm.

advice: Pred odhodom preverite, ali naprave obratujejo.
